meta.title: The Talent Show
meta.textType: story: what people can and can't do

paragraphs: The school talent show is on Friday at two o'clock. It is in the school hall, and it is like a small concert. The hall has a stage with a red curtain. Teacher Kim stands at the front. She asks the children, "Have you ever been on a stage?" "No, never," says Leo. "Yes, in a school play," says May. Then the first act begins.

Leo goes on the stage and stands at the front. "I can whistle, but I can't dance," he says. He whistles a happy tune. May sits at a big drum. "The drum is my favorite instrument," she says. May can play fast, and the audience claps. "That is brilliant!" says Teacher Kim. Mia stands to one side in a queen costume. She has a paper crown and a long dress. Lily is the designer of the costume. "Could you help me with my crown, Lily?" asks Mia.

Tom sits in the front row. "I can't sing, but I can clap," he says. Then Leo plays a guessing game. He holds a bowl and a spoon above his head. "It is round and hot," says Leo. "You can eat it with a spoon." "Soup!" says the audience. "Yes!" says Leo, and he bows.

Teacher Kim says, "Could you turn on the music, please, Lily?" Lily turns on the music for the last act. Leo, May, and Mia stand on the stage and bow. Leo can't dance, but he claps and smiles. Everyone claps. "Have you ever been on a stage, Tom?" asks Mia. "No, never," says Tom, "but I can clap!"
